slices.brief:
S3 = pure Slurm helpers + local job store + `status` command.
1. src/dicos/slurm.py (pure, no I/O): parse_time('30m'|'6h'|'2d'|'1d12h'|'90s') -> Slurm time string (D-HH:MM:SS or HH:MM:SS); raw Slurm formats (e.g. '06:00:00', '1-00:00:00', '30') pass through unchanged; invalid -> ValueError. render_job_script(id, partition, time, cpus, mem|None, gpus, jobdir, setup|None, command, src_dir) exactly per spec 'Job script' (omit --mem when None, omit --gres when gpus==0, setup None -> default uv block from spec, setup '' -> nothing). map_state(raw) per spec 'Job states' (CANCELLED* prefix, strip trailing '+' or ' by N'). parse_sbatch_parsable('12345' or '12345;cluster') -> '12345'. parse_squeue(text) for `squeue -h -j <ids> -o %i|%T` -> {id: state}. parse_sacct(text) for `sacct -j <ids> -P -n -o JobID,State,ExitCode,Start,End` -> {id: (state, exit_code int, start, end)} using only top-level JobID rows (skip '.batch', '.extern', '.0'); exit code from 'N:M' -> N. parse_partitions(text) for `scontrol show partition -o` -> list of dict(name, allow_accounts list|['ALL'], max_time, state, tres/gres if present); parse_sinfo(text) for `sinfo -h -o '%P|%G|%F|%l'` -> per partition (strip trailing '*' default marker) gres, nodes A/I/O/T, timelimit.
2. src/dicos/store.py: SQLite at $DICOS_HOME/dicos.db (created 0600 via os.open then sqlite connect; WAL off ok), schema exactly per spec 'SQLite jobs table'; add(project, prefix, **fields) allocates seq = per-project MAX(seq)+1 inside BEGIN IMMEDIATE, returns id f'{prefix}-{seq}'; get(id); list(status=None, limit=20|None) newest first; update(id, **fields) that refuses to change status of a terminal job (succeeded/failed/cancelled/lost) and refuses invalid transitions (queued->running/succeeded/failed/cancelled/lost, running->succeeded/failed/cancelled/lost); active() non-terminal jobs.
3. CLI `status [--all]`: ensure master, one remote call running both `sinfo -h -o '%P|%G|%F|%l'` and `scontrol show partition -o` and the account (`sacctmgr -n show assoc user=$USER format=account -P | head -1`), with a separator line; rich table PARTITION, GRES, NODES idle/total, TIMELIMIT; exclude partitions whose AllowAccounts excludes the account (case-insensitive; 'ALL' allows) unless --all, which adds an ALLOWED column. Use conn functions; LoginError -> message + exit 1.
4. Tests: unit tests for every slurm.py function (include real-looking samples), store (seq per project, concurrent add from 2 threads gives distinct seqs, terminal protection, file mode 0600), status via CliRunner with conn.run monkeypatched.

slices.brief:
S4 = `run --sync` + `list`, `show`, `logs`, `stop` (git mode is S5: in S4, `run` without --sync must exit 1 with 'git mode not implemented yet, use --sync').
1. Project resolution per spec: inside a git repo use its toplevel and origin URL matched against config.projects[*].repo (auto-register name=basename of repo, prefix=name sanitized to ^[A-Za-z0-9_-]+$, setup=None, save config); outside a git repo in --sync mode use cwd basename as project with repo=None.
2. Resources: flags -p/--partition, --gpus, --cpus, --mem, -t/--time override config.defaults; partition required (clear error if neither flag nor default); defaults gpus 0, cpus 1, time '1h'. Time via slurm.parse_time.
3. Workdir: config.workdir required (error: run dicos init). jobdir = <workdir>/jobs/<id>.
4. Sync shipping: rsync -az --delete from the project root (git toplevel or cwd) to <jobdir>/src/ with `-e` set to the mux ssh command (conn.ssh_argv base without command, joined; must include ControlPath, ControlMaster=no, BatchMode=yes, ProxyCommand=false), excluding .git/, .venv/, __pycache__/, and honoring .gitignore via --filter=':- .gitignore'; create jobdir first via conn.run('mkdir -p ...').
5. Write job.sh through conn.run with input=script (`cat > <jobdir>/job.sh`), then `sbatch --parsable <jobdir>/job.sh`; parse id; store job (mode 'sync', slurm_id, remote_dir=jobdir, status queued). If sbatch fails, record status failed with the error text and exit 1. Print `<id> (slurm <n>) queued on <partition>`.
6. Command after `--`: single argv kept verbatim, multiple joined with shlex.join (same rule as exec).
7. refresh(store, cfg): for active jobs, one remote call with squeue + sacct (per spec) separated by a marker line; apply map_state; set started_at/finished_at/exit_code/slurm_state/error; job found in neither -> lost. Never update terminal jobs. Called by list/show.
8. `list [-s STATUS] [--all]` table ID, STATUS, PARTITION, GPUS, SLURM, CREATED, COMMAND (truncate command); `show ID` all fields plus, when queued, the Reason from `scontrol show job <slurm_id>`; `logs ID [-n 200] [-f]` = exec_interactive of `tail -n N <jobdir>/output.log` or `tail -n N -F ...`; `stop ID`: queued/running -> `scancel <slurm_id>`, mark cancelled; terminal -> message, exit 0. Unknown ID -> exit 1.
9. Tests: project resolution, resource merging, rsync argv, job.sh upload + sbatch flow with conn.run fake, sbatch failure, refresh state transitions incl. lost, list/show/logs/stop via CliRunner with fakes.

slices.brief:
S5 = git-mode shipping (default for `run`), `wait`, `clean`.
1. Local commit resolution like lab (read lab/gitutil.py): default target HEAD requires a clean tree (untracked files ignored only if lab ignores them; follow lab) and HEAD reachable from a remote-tracking branch of origin; --branch/--commit/--tag (mutually exclusive) resolve the ref via `git fetch origin` into a temporary refs/dicos-submit/<uuid> namespace, verify the commit exists on origin, delete temp refs; dirty tree allowed with an explicit target. Requires origin URL; project registered as in S4.
2. Remote (one conn.run script, with agent forwarding: conn.ssh_argv(..., agent=True) / run(agent=True) so private GitHub repos clone via the user's local ssh-agent): repos/<project> base clone (`git clone <origin>` if missing else `git fetch --quiet origin`), then `git -C repos/<project> worktree add --detach <jobdir>/src <sha>`; failure -> clear error, job recorded failed. Then same job.sh + sbatch path as S4 (refactor shared code, keep S4 behaviour). Store mode 'git', commit_sha.
3. `wait ID [--timeout S] [--interval 15]`: refresh loop until terminal; exit 0 succeeded, 1 failed, 2 cancelled, 3 lost, 124 timeout; prints final status line.
4. `clean ID [-y]`: only terminal jobs (else exit 1); confirm unless -y; remove <jobdir> remotely; for git mode run `git -C repos/<project> worktree prune` after removal (or `worktree remove --force` first). Mark nothing else.
5. Remove the S4 'git mode not implemented' guard.
6. Tests: commit resolution in temp git repos with a local bare 'origin' (clean/dirty/unpushed/--branch/--tag/--commit), remote script content, wait exit codes and timeout with fake refresh, clean rules.

slices.brief:
S6 = `sweep`, `update`, README, plus one otp fix.
1. `sweep FILE.yaml [-p --gpus --cpus --mem -t --sync --branch/--commit/--tag]`: file format like lab sweep (read lab/sweep.py): `command` template with {key} placeholders, `grid` mapping key -> list (cartesian product, deterministic order), optional resource keys (partition, gpus, cpus, mem, time) overridden by flags. Ship code once (same git/sync path as run), render ONE job.sh with `#SBATCH --array=0-(N-1)`, output/error `<jobdir>/output_%a.log`, and a bash array of the N rendered commands (each safely quoted) selected by $SLURM_ARRAY_TASK_ID. jobdir is the first element's id dir; store one local record per element (consecutive seqs), slurm_id '<arrayid>_<i>', same remote_dir, and make refresh/logs/stop/wait/clean handle array elements (logs reads output_<i>.log; stop uses scancel <arrayid>_<i>; clean removes the shared dir only when all elements are terminal).
2. `update [--check]`: same pattern as lab update (read lab/update.py): find install source from the installed distribution's direct_url.json; --check compares remote git HEAD with installed commit; otherwise `uv tool install --reinstall <source>`.
3. README.md: what dicos is, requirements (allow-listed jump host), install via `uvx --from git+<repo-url> dicos` / `uv tool install`, `dicos init` walkthrough (TOTP secret or Google Authenticator export QR), safety notes (5 failed logins ban the jump host IP; login.failed latch and how to clear it; credentials stored 0600 in ~/.dicos), command reference table, examples for run (git and --sync), sweep, logs, wait.
4. otp.py: when an otpauth-migration export contains several accounts, unsupported entries (non-TOTP, non-SHA1, non-6-digit) must be skipped instead of rejecting the whole export; error only if no usable account remains. Update tests.
5. Tests: sweep expansion/ordering, array job.sh rendering with quoting, per-element records and array-aware refresh/stop/logs/clean, update source detection.
6. Small S2 follow-ups: (a) doctor 'sinfo' row DETAIL shows only the partition count (e.g. '32 partitions'), not the full list; (b) init workdir detection: wrap remote `sacctmgr` and `ls /ceph/work` with `timeout 60`, print 'Detecting remote work directory…' before it, and add a local subprocess timeout of 180 s to that conn.run call (on timeout: clear error, exit 1, saved files stay); (c) interactive init without --jump/--no-jump: when no login.failed marker exists, probe the candidates before prompting and show the reachability table (restore D5); keep skipping probes while latched.
